claims.text: No generator's output on an undeciphered system is scored under this study before that generator has passed the conformance preflight of spec.md section 2 as registered at records/registration-2026-11-27.md section 2: synthetic ground-truth recovery at the registered floors; the deciphered-control clause in its R1 form, with the Latin/Meroitic positional limitation carried on the record's face rather than passed silently; and exact two-implementation agreement on every ground-truth set and recovery figure.
